params.prompt: No logos, no money, no numbers, no people, no thumbs-up gesture. Square 1:1 advertising key visual, dynamic low camera angle, high-end commercial 3D render, cinematic sunlight. A classic dart-shaped paper airplane, correctly folded: sharp pointed nose, two large symmetrical flat triangular wings, and a narrow center keel fold underneath, flying diagonally upward to the upper right. The airplane is clearly folded from a long white Korean hospital medical receipt: on the top surface of the wings the printed receipt layout is visible with a bold Korean header reading exactly '진료비 영수증', dashed separator lines and rows of small grey placeholder bars (no numbers, no amounts). the 3D cartoon mascot from the reference image (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair like a flower, round peach face with rosy cheeks and simple smiling eyes, red sweater with a white letter M) sits happily on top of the airplane near the back, one arm raised in joy. Speed lines, wind streaks, small fluffy clouds, warm sun flare, soft cream-to-sky-blue gradient background. The airplane and Meri occupy the center-right of the frame; the upper-left 40% and the bottom 25% are clean background for text. Only the Korean text '진료비 영수증', no other readable text.
